decisions.reason: As the flagship digital patient app closely aligned with the firm's connected practice direction, its strategic option value remains high and uncertainty low enough to keep with minimal drop probability.
The remote screen sharing support tool is a low-cost complementary option that continues to support existing software and can be kept while its value remains clear.
The practice performance analytics dashboard builds on established software and supports efficiency goals, so it is worth keeping as a moderate option with some residual uncertainty about adoption.
The complete dental practice bundle is close to the core offer and likely leverages existing customer relationships, justifying a low drop probability and continued commitment.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm's established software capabilities and shows no evidence of becoming a valuable option, so it is likely to be abandoned to free resources.
